calculation_policy.credit_card_bonus_stacking: Only the highest applicable credit-card APY bonus applies; card bonuses do not stack with one another.
calculation_policy.checking_boost_stacking: Only the highest applicable checking APY boost applies; checking boosts do not stack with one another.
calculation_policy.cross_type_stacking: The selected card bonus may stack with a qualifying checking boost and other documented relationship or tier bonuses.
calculation_policy.estimate_formula: For a balance held for one year, estimate net return as balance * effective APY / 100 - annual card fee.

savings_accounts.name: Gold Plus Account
savings_accounts.notes: Interest compounds daily. Gold Rewards Card bonus is automatically applied when products are under the same customer profile.

credit_cards.name: Gold Rewards Card
credit_cards.notes: Approval and initial credit limit remain subject to underwriting.

checking_pairing_note: Only enumerated checking/savings pairings qualify for a linked-checking APY boost. A Light Blue checking account is not an enumerated qualifying pairing for Gold Plus Account, so its Gold Plus checking boost is 0%.
